title: What's new in Shopify Connector: Overview
summary: This overview covers what changed in the Shopify connector in the new release. The first half demos item sync changes (tariff codes, a toggle to stop mapping by barcode, the unlisted status), skipped-record visibility in the role center, and the two feedback buttons on the shop card. It then explains B2B changes: company sync, catalogs by Shopify plan, markets versus B2B catalogs, guidance against catalogs linked to several companies, and country extensions for Belgium and the US that fix tax ID handling. The second half demos the use Shopify order number setting, contact numbers on Shopify orders, and exchange returns with return orders, credit memos and moving negative lines. It ends with new tax details on refunds and orders in a pre-release build, and points to a separate video for tax.

chapters.title: Intro: areas of change in the Shopify connector
Item sync: tariff codes and barcode mapping
B2B catalog import and duplicate catalog guidance
Company tax ID and Belgium/US country extensions

features.name: Tariff code sync (country of origin and HS code)
features.description: The tariff number and country from the Business Central item card (foreign trade) are now sent to Shopify as harmonized system code and country of origin. A new toggle on the Shopify shop card controls import and export of tariff codes.
caveats: When importing tariff codes from Shopify, they are not created automatically; if not in the tariff list they are ignored.
prerequisites: Tariff number and country set on the item card under cost and posting
Toggle enabled in item and product synchronization on the shop card

features.name: Find mapping by barcode toggle
features.description: A new field, hidden by default and added through personalization, controls whether the connector falls back to barcode search in item references when SKU mapping fails. Disabling it avoids several items or variants being connected to the same Business Central variant, but then mapping must be done manually.
caveats: Field is hidden by default and needs personalization to show
With it disabled, mapping must be done manually
prerequisites: Add the field to the shop card with personalization

features.name: Unlisted product status
features.description: The connector supports Shopify's new unlisted status. An unlisted product can be sold through a direct link but is not visible in the online store.

features.name: Skipped record notification during price sync
features.description: Running price sync in the foreground now shows a notification when records are skipped. A blocked item (sales blocked) cannot get a calculated price because the connector builds a temporary sales quote, so it is skipped.
caveats: A job queue run is still marked successful even when items are skipped
Skipped records can be searched from anywhere

features.name: Skipped records and API errors in the role center
features.description: The Shopify activities part of the role center now includes counts of skipped records and API errors. This avoids opening each store one by one to find synchronization problems.

features.name: Provide feedback button on the Shopify shop
features.description: Besides the leave-a-review action that posts publicly to the Shopify app store, a Microsoft-specific provide feedback button lets users report problems with details, screenshots or files. The content is visible only to the Microsoft development center team, and users can choose to be contacted.
caveats: App store reviews give very limited contact information about the author

features.name: B2B company synchronization visible by default
features.description: Shopify made B2B available on all plans with some restrictions. B2B company synchronization is now visible by default, and adding a company in Business Central creates the company, a customer and a catalog on Shopify.
caveats: Not every Shopify B2B capability is available on all plans; all but one are supported by the connector

features.name: Auto create B2B catalog and market catalogs
features.description: The auto create B2B catalog toggle creates a catalog linked to the company location on Shopify so Business Central prices apply. The speaker contrasts this with market catalogs (region, B2B, POS) as an alternative for simpler plans.
caveats: Auto create B2B catalog toggle and company-location catalogs are only available for Plus and advanced plans
Old B2B catalogs and market catalogs are two different flavors
prerequisites: Shopify Plus or advanced plan for company-location catalogs

features.name: B2B catalog import and duplicate catalog guidance
features.description: B2B catalogs are only imported when the corresponding company exists in Business Central, so companies must be synchronized first. A Shopify catalog linked to two company locations shows up twice in Business Central, and this version now prevents price sync in that situation and recommends market catalogs instead.
caveats: One Shopify catalog cannot hold different prices per customer, so the last sync would overwrite earlier ones
Catalog price logic comes from the customer (price group, discount group, tax inclusion)
prerequisites: Companies synchronized into Business Central before getting catalogs

features.name: Company tax registration ID and Belgium/US nano extensions
features.description: Tax registration IDs from Shopify companies were already imported for mapping, but not populated when creating a customer, because Belgium has a local VAT field that caused errors. The connector stays one W1 version for all, with two small country extensions for Belgium and the US. The Belgian one adds an Enterprise number option to the company tax ID mapping.
features.status_evidence_quote: we are releasing two small extensions, nano extensions, I would say.
caveats: Not available in AppSource, distributed a different way
A notification prompts installation of the connector extension for Belgium or the US
US extension capabilities are not detailed
Before this, the company and customer VAT field was not populated in Business Central
prerequisites: Install the Belgium or US extension via the in-product notification

features.name: Use Shopify order number
features.description: A new setting in the order synchronization section of the Shopify shop card lets sales orders and invoices use the Shopify order number as the document number, with a Shopify number series. The setting is inherited from the setup when an order is imported.
caveats: Sales invoice and sales order documents must support manual numbers
Orders imported before the toggle was activated keep the old number; unlink and mark the document as not processed, then create it again
Shopify numbers look different in the sales order list, so review compatibility with Business Central numbers because sorting may be affected
prerequisites: Manual numbers enabled on sales order and invoice number series

features.name: Contact numbers on Shopify orders
features.description: After personalizing the page, sell-to, bill-to and ship-to contact numbers can be shown on the Shopify order. They are populated automatically and can be changed when there is more than one contact.
caveats: Fields were added to the page through personalization in the demo

features.name: Exchange returns and order edits handling
features.description: Refunds with returned and exchange items can create a return order or a credit memo, chosen in the return and refund processing setting. The standard Move Negative Lines action then creates a sales order (default for return orders) or invoice (default for credit memos) for the exchange line and leaves the return order with the returned line.
caveats: Credit memos are not compatible with directed put-away and pick or other advanced warehouse scenarios, so use return orders there
A return order with one positive and one negative line can still be posted as is
The document may need to be reopened before moving negative lines
prerequisites: Shop setting for process return as credit memo or return order
Advanced warehouse customers should use return orders

features.name: Tax details on Shopify refunds and orders
features.description: The Shopify refund page gets a tax fact box and tax lines. The Shopify order invoice details now show tax area code and tax liable, and you can override these values so the standard mapping is not triggered when the sales document is created.
features.status_evidence_quote: This is a pre-release version in the reality this fact box will be down.
caveats: Fact box position will change in the final version
No tax in the demo transaction
Manual population is probably not wanted; a separate video covers tax in detail
